name: The Table
description: A thin AI Game Master spine: a game protocol (GameSession — reset/observe/legal_moves/step/is_terminal/result) any game engine implements, a game-agnostic GM driver loop, a name -> factory registry, and a ledger sink that records each turn into an ai-game-master campaign box. This is a walking skeleton — THREE games (bureau, single-seat; crazy_eights, 4-seat with hidden info and rules reused from game-lab; scene, single-seat narrative dice scene reusing apps/game's roll engine) registered in the_table/registry.py and driven end to end, all through the identical driver and sink, by a single registry-driven proof (the_table/proof.py) that loops over every registered game and asserts each is remembered in a tamper-evident ledger that ai-game-master's own verifier accepts.
author: USER / Claude
network: none. Pure Python, stdlib-only, no sockets, no HTTP client. bureau_adapter.py imports bureau (apps/bureau) and crazy_eights_adapter.py imports game-lab's crazy_eights sim (apps/game-lab/sims) via local sys.path shims; nothing under apps/bureau or apps/game-lab is modified.

notes.injects: bureau's real Session (apps/bureau/bureau/play.py) as the first GameSession implementation, game-lab's real Crazy Eights rule functions (apps/game-lab/sims/crazy_eights.py: is_legal, legal_cards, make_deck, SUITS) as the second, and is shaped to compose with the ai-game-master library surfaces (apps/ai-game-master) as the GM loop and ledger. Nothing under apps/bureau, apps/game-lab, or apps/ai-game-master is modified — the-table is a consumer of all three, never the reverse.
notes.own_box_only: This app touches only its own box: no store_scope, no network, no writes outside a caller-supplied box dir. The bureau and game-lab imports are read-only (module imports via a local sys.path shim, not data dependencies); ledger_sink.py provisions and writes an ai-game-master campaign.db under a box dir the caller chooses, and never seals canon (append-only session_open/turn/session_close rows only — sealing is a human act, verified by ai-game-master's --canon guard).
notes.permissions_2026-08-28: store_write moved here from apps/ai-game-master's manifest: ai-game-master ships zero engine code (schemas + bootstrap + a throwaway-temp-dir exhibit only) and never itself opens a campaign box at runtime, while the_table/ledger_sink.py is the module that actually opens campaign.db and appends session_open/turn/session_close rows against ai-game-master's own schema/verifier. store_scope stays empty on purpose (see own_box_only above) — the box path is caller-supplied per call, not a fixed lane this app owns — so this declares a capability, not a scope.
notes.walking_skeleton: Three games plus a registry, complete: the_table/game_session.py (the pinned GameSession Protocol contract); the_table/bureau_adapter.py (BureauSession, seats=1, the first real implementation over apps/bureau); the_table/crazy_eights_adapter.py (CrazyEightsSession, seats=4, the second real implementation, reusing game-lab's real Crazy Eights rule functions for all legality, owning its own seeded RNG, and exposing per-seat hidden information via observe()); the_table/game_engine_adapter.py (SceneSession, seats=1, the third real implementation, reusing apps/game's Engine.roll dice rule for a freeform narrative scene, never touching apps/game/engine_state.json); the_table/registry.py (a small name -> zero-arg-factory registry — register/make/games/describe — with all three built-ins registered at import time, each factory returning a fresh session); the_table/ledger_sink.py (records turns into an ai-game-master box, reusing its own hash scheme, unmodified across all three games); the_table/gm.py (the game-agnostic driver loop, seat-agnostic via current_seat, GMError on a max_turns cap, unmodified across all three games); the_table/proof.py (registry-driven: loops over registry.games(), drives each fresh session end to end into its own fresh ledger box one game at a time — never interleaved, since scene reseeds the global random module — and asserts ai-game-master's own verify_ledger.py accepts every chain; exits 0 only if all registered games verify). Tests: test_bureau_adapter.py, test_crazy_eights_adapter.py, test_game_engine_adapter.py, test_ledger_sink.py, test_gm.py, test_registry.py. Not yet: the narrative/AI side composing multiple games at one table — a later bite.
